name: @natjswenson/forge
description: Generate GitHub Actions workflows that are verified, not hoped for — refs resolved to pinned SHAs, actionlint and zizmor clean, in one second
author: Nate Swenson
_dependencies_comment: No npm dependency on @natjswenson/press yet, deliberately. lib/header.mjs resolves press from the in-repo checkout first and falls back to node_modules, and forge is not published in 0.1.0 (see CHANGELOG) — so declaring ^0.8.0 only broke `npm install` in CI against a version that does not exist on the registry until press 0.8.0 actually releases. Add the real dependency in the same change that turns npm-publish on.
